user.description: Add Heads Up. Banners are created by the `heads_up.create_banner` action.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Heads Up is already set up.

data.evict: Evict the oldest lowest-severity banner when full

data_description.evict: When off, creating a banner beyond the maximum fails with an error.
data_description.default_dismiss_scope: Used when an action call sets no dismiss_scope.
data_description.default_timeout: Used when an action call sets no timeout. Warning: if you clear this field, banners without their own timeout stay until they are dismissed or cleared.

not_loaded.message: Heads Up is not set up. Add the integration first.

too_many_banners.message: Heads Up already holds {max} banners and none can be evicted.

create_banner.name: Create banner
create_banner.description: Shows a banner in every Heads Up card. Calling it again with the same ID replaces the banner.

id.name: ID
id.description: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _; up to 64 characters. Generated and returned when empty.

severity.name: Severity
severity.description: Sets color, default icon and sort order.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Replaces the default icon of the severity.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: The banner disappears after this time, also across restarts. 0 = no timeout. Empty = default from the integration options.

dismissible.name: Dismissible
dismissible.description: Shows a close button on the banner.

dismiss_scope.name: Dismiss scope
dismiss_scope.description: Per user: closing hides it only for that user. Everyone: closing removes it for all.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Group name for card filters and for clearing several banners at once.

tap_action.name: Tap action
tap_action.description: Home Assistant action config run when the banner is tapped, e.g. navigate.

clear_banner.name: Clear banner
clear_banner.description: Removes banners by ID, by tag, or both. Returns the number removed.

id.name: ID
id.description: ID of the banner to remove.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Removes every banner with this tag.

clear_all.name: Clear all banners
clear_all.description: Removes every banner. Returns the number removed.
